# Results (aggregate, regenerated by `scripts/run_pipeline.py`)

All tables derive from the single verified vintage `who_prov_2026-10-17` unless named otherwise.

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `tables/coverage_by_year_*.csv` | Rows, frequency, coverage codes, zero/negative cells, complete H1, H1 maturity in days |
| `tables/pair_flow_*.csv` | Inclusion/exclusion flow of year pairs by reason |
| `tables/threshold_counts_*.csv` | Pairs with H1 decline >= 5/10/15/20%, strict / relaxed / balanced |
| `tables/h1_ratios_strict_*.csv` | Per-country strict H1 totals and ratios (WHO national aggregates) |
| `tables/within_vintage_bootstrap_*.csv` | Country-cluster bootstrap CI for share of pairs with decline >= 10% |
| `tables/cross_vintage_status.csv` | `NOT_COMPUTABLE` — fewer than two verified vintages |
| `figures/coverage_*.png`, `figures/h1_ratios_*.png` | Coverage thinning; within-vintage H1 ratios with thresholds |
| `run_summary.json` | Code commit, configuration, vintage hashes, headline counts |

Within-vintage statistics describe year-on-year change in one file, **not** revision reliability.
